basic_info.description: Fabulous two level home with abundant charm at a prime Eureka Valley location. This four-bedroom/three-bath residence is situated on a full and level lot. With a formal entrance leading to the main level you will instantly appreciate the abundance of period details. The living room is filled with natural light, has a wood burning fireplace, recessed ceiling and adjacent anteroom. The formal dining room has natural wood wainscoting and leads directly to a kitchen with stainless appliances and direct deck access. Completing this level is a cozy bedroom and a full bath with shower over tub. The top floor has three bedrooms and two baths on one level including a double-parlor primary suite with fireplace and en-suite bathroom. The ground level has a large utility room with a laundry area, 1-car garage and a rear yard with mature trees. If interested in Exceptional Value. See this home immediately.
